title: A failed operation blocks its result locally but leaves later operations available
summary: A narrow failure model makes a failure marker suppress only the result of the immediately associated operation; subsequent independent operations remain executable.

design.unit: multi-operation records with one marked failure, an associated result slot, and a later independent operation
design.prediction: Only the failed operation’s result slot should be absent or marked unresolved; a later operation with its own input should retain its result.
design.countermodel: The same sequence could result from missing records, editorial omission, or context-conditioned lexical conventions without the proposed functional rule.
design.falsifier: A single failure suppresses all later results, or the failed operation still produces its result while a later independent operation is suppressed.
design.principal_risk: Failure and result status need independent annotations. Near IDEA000073/074 and action/result routes; retained only as a narrow propagation rule, not a polarity or agent claim.
